ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; visible white pixel intensity dominant (estimated ~85%) against black peripheral margins (estimated ~15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central high-intensity (white) region across both lobes. Low-intensity (black) peripheral banding along the trailing and lateral edges. Right lobe exhibits significant irregular black pixel encroachment along the upper margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a pixel depth reaching approximately 1/3 of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge; most prominent on the right lobe distal half.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trajectory on the posterior edges sweeping upward toward the distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular black pigmentation/mottling along the trailing edge of the right lobe; isolated dark pixel clusters (specks) visible on the medial-left lobe surface.
